policy: VerifyUSD-Mcontract clauses separately from spot/COIN-M. Distinguish notice publish timestamp, assumed+5minavailability, new-position cutoff and terminal settlement. Current article captures do not certify original historical content versions. Current metadata is a cross-check only. Source rows at or after termination remain archived but cannot establish executable trades or payable funding. Terminal settlement price and fee remain null unless independently verified.
eligibility_preview: Apply known hard cutoff at decision time only when notice claimed available. Do not backdate exclusions to periods before the notice. No relisting/rename stitching; new contracts require separate lifecycle identities. Before computing any future rolling feature also exclude whole-day bars spanning or following confirmed settlement.
